integrity: The phase diagram is derived from exact differentiation and sign analysis of the cited scalar alternative equation. Fold and cusp transfer use the cited dual-equation theorem; no numerical sampling is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the cited three-species four-reaction network and its positive-equilibrium reduction; no claim is made about stability away from folds, global dynamics, or other networks.
title: Exact fold and multistationarity phase diagram for a three-species mass-action example
